crossRefs.note: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.
The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.
He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.

translations.web: who gives food to every creature; for his loving kindness endures forever.
translations.bsb: He gives food to every creature. His loving devotion endures forever.
translations.kjv: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy endureth for ever.
translations.asv: Who giveth food to all flesh; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
